//point: Main visual representation of the marker on the map

point.//point_content: Optional. Content of the marker, displayed in the popup when the marker is clicked, if null -- the popup is not displayed

point_content.name: Demo Map Center
point_content.//pictures: Optional, by default - []. Pictures to display in the description section, if empty -- the section is not displayed
point_content.//description: Optional, by default - null, text to display in the description section, if empty -- the section is not displayed
point_content.description: A main attraction that stays visible and does not cluster.
point_content.//link: Optional, by default - null link in the description section, if null -- the section is not displayd
point_content.//google_link: Optional, by default - null. If non-empty, used for Open in Google Maps; if empty/null, the link is built from coordinates.
point_content.//includeInCategorySearch: Optional, by default - false. Includes the marker in the category search, if true -- needs to be a category id from the categories.json
point_content.//isCollapsible: Optional, by default - false. Collapsed with other markers in the same zone
point_content.//isNested: Optional, by default - false. Contains nested markers, if true -- needs to be a file name of the nested zone
